records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Several deposit-paying pilots in one narrowly defined battery segment should demonstrate that operators insert the gate before approval, suppliers produce usable evidence, delivery and exception hours remain within scope, fully loaded contribution margin is attractive, a laboratory or adviser channel converts economically, and customers return for additional suppliers, models, or annual support.

records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: The regulator reported only 135 dynamic-price customers in the initial measured period, while utilities and equipment vendors can bundle basic scheduling into existing relationships at no separate fee.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Observed invoice cohorts across several field-service firms, measured rekeying and rejection costs, paid pilots with recurring use, a signed accounting channel, proven export or authorization flows, and support-adjusted contribution margins after stabilization are needed.
records.primary_score_limiter: The differentiation may collapse into an easily bundled accounting or field-service feature, and no evidence yet shows persistent paid pain after the KSeF rollout stabilizes.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Official client and offline tooling already provide a workable fallback, while accounting vendors have the installed base and incentive to add mobile field capture at negligible incremental price.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Category-specific completed-job data covering quote accuracy, ticket size, parts availability, first-time-fix rate, turnaround, disputes, logistics cost, repairer take-rate acceptance, channel CAC, and paid repeat volume is required.
records.primary_score_limiter: The proposal lacks proof that low-frequency demand, marketplace acquisition, logistics, and dispute costs leave positive contribution, while neither consumer demand nor repair supply is controlled.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: A public European repair platform is planned and manufacturers must expose repair offers directly, while low-value goods can remain cheaper to replace than collect, diagnose, and repair.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Signed supplier pricing and coverage, paid dealer pilots, vehicles tested per visit, completion and failure rates, fully loaded contribution per certificate, and credible evidence that certificates improve sale speed, realized price, financing acceptance, or dispute incidence are required.
records.primary_score_limiter: The venture owns neither the diagnostic supply nor the dealer or marketplace channel, and the visible EUR 99 price anchor may not leave enough margin for an intermediary after fulfillment and acquisition costs.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: The core vendor already sells directly to consumers and businesses, OEM dealers can expose battery-management readings cheaply, and the existing price anchor leaves little economic room for shipping, inspection, support, and channel share.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Paid triggered engagements, observed hours and adviser cost avoided, acceptance of the same passport by multiple requesters, bounded delivery labor, first-year contribution margin, annual renewal, mapping reuse, and signed accounting-channel referrals would support a higher score.
records.primary_score_limiter: The standard is voluntary, free official tools exist, and there is no evidence that Polish SMEs or accounting partners will pay for a passport rather than self-serve, bundle the work, or wait until a counterparty forces action.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: The Commission and EFRAG already offer a digital template and support material, while regulatory simplification may reduce downstream questionnaires, leaving only a small and readily bundled service layer.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Obtain a serial-number-level census for at least several installer or O&M portfolios; model-specific failure, repair, lead-time, and downtime-cost records; certified compatibility and test procedures; documented authentic supply with landed costs and write-down terms; and signed paid reservations whose cohort revenue covers inventory, support, warranty, and expected losses under conservative failure scenarios.
records.primary_score_limiter: There is no evidence that any sufficiently large homogeneous cohort combines frequent or costly failures, genuine replacement scarcity, and reservation willingness at a price that covers inventory write-downs and SLA delivery.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Established European providers already offer component-level inverter repair, maintenance contracts, stocked parts, refurbished inverter sales, and replacement procurement; this weakens the claim that a new regional reserve has a uniquely unavailable supply solution, while the candidate's own IEA sources do not document inverter-model scarcity.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A paid multi-installer pilot should show callback arrival rates by postcode and device, reservation conversion and renewal, dispatch acceptance, travel time, technician fill rate, first-visit resolution, repeat work, credits, fully loaded contribution margin, and whether installers permit the operator to coordinate service without harming warranties or customer trust.
records.primary_score_limiter: No evidence yet establishes incident density, reservation willingness to pay, or the utilization and travel profile needed for the promised SLA to produce attractive contribution margin rather than field-service losses.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: The closest contrary evidence is that existing providers already advertise nationwide or manufacturer-backed service: Serwis112 claims a verified nationwide network and response in as little as 48 hours (https://serwis112.pl/), while Fronius maintains trained service partners and some Plus partners accept systems they did not install (https://www.fronius.com/pl-pl/poland/energia-sloneczna/firmy/kontakt/znajdz-instalatora). This weakens novelty and shows installers may have channel alternatives, although neither source proves the proposed B2B reservation model lacks demand.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Evidence should include the number and annual dossier volume of reachable adviser firms, paid design partners, measured hours and reviewer findings saved per dossier, renewal and per-dossier price acceptance, implementation and support effort, legal-update cost, standards licensing terms, security requirements, and independent auditor or counsel acceptance of generated packs.
records.primary_score_limiter: The addressable repeated-dossier volume and adviser willingness to pay are unverified, while the core templates and mappings are easy to reproduce and face both free official guidance and much deeper governance platforms.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: The European Commission already operates a free official AI Act Compliance Checker (https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en), and commercial incumbents advertise overlapping automated evidence and audit outputs, including OneTrust (https://www.onetrust.com/solutions/ai-governance/) and Credo AI (https://www.credo.ai/product). In addition, CEN-CENELEC states that reproduction or exploitation of standards content requires advance licensing (https://www.cencenelec.eu/european-standardization/ipr-and-patents/copyright/). Together these facts directly weaken differentiation and complicate the proposed content asset, though they do not disprove demand for a cheaper Polish adviser-specific workflow.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A counsel-reviewed transaction structure, one funder term sheet, and a cohort of real installer files showing receivable size, cash-gap duration, approval rate, fraud and defect rate, all-in funding cost, installer willingness to pay, processing labor, and repeat volume.
records.primary_score_limiter: The proposed product has not established that the relevant subsidy or contract payment stream is legally financeable on terms that leave enough value for both the installer and the intermediary.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Existing 35% program prefinancing and free operator assistance reduce two parts of the claimed gap, while subsidy eligibility itself does not establish assignability or collateral value.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Three to five paid plant pilots showing pre-repair loss, implementation rate, verified twelve-month savings, attribution stability, gross contribution after field and channel costs, sales-cycle length, renewal or multi-site expansion, and a direct benchmark against incumbent audit offers.
records.primary_score_limiter: Incumbent service providers already control plant relationships and field capability, while the proposed venture lacks a protected channel, exclusive data right, or proven advantage large enough to overcome that position.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Established compressor vendors already sell leak-detection programs, demonstrating demand but undermining novelty and making it likely that audits, monitoring, and repairs can be bundled by suppliers with existing site trust.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Backtest actual 15-minute meter data from at least 30-50 target sites against each retailer's complete formula, network charges, taxes, comfort constraints, and battery degradation; then run controlled paid pilots showing incremental net savings, conversion at the proposed fee, support hours, reliability, churn intent, and CAC, alongside a signed installer channel and verified access for the chosen device stack.
records.primary_score_limiter: The available household market and per-site net savings are too uncertain to support the proposed subscription economics after customer acquisition, device-fragmentation support, and competition from free or bundled controls.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: URE's full-year 2025 data show that only 4,836 households, at most 0.03% of the segment, used dynamic-price contracts despite 48% smart-meter penetration, while current Polish products publicly offer cross-vendor tariff-aware control for PV, batteries, EVs, heat pumps, and other loads; this directly challenges both near-term market size and differentiation.
